_meta.notes: 4-page PDF self-paginates 1 of 3 / 2 of 3 / 3 of 3 with the cover an unnumbered extra sheet (matches audit prior). No county Schedule A/B grid pages; filer-produced replicas with a 'Complete Address' header ARE the schedules. Form titled '2024 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'; year-end report signed January 24, 2025. Summary line 7 prints '176.40' with no dollar sign. Column B aggregates HANDWRITTEN: contributions $52,026.00; expenditures read at 600dpi as $51,942.82 — the chunk file's audit_notes prior says $51942.92; the page governs (cents read .82, not .92). The filer's Column B chain also carries its own arithmetic gaps (Sept ColB 31,621.00 + Oct 11,642.25 + Dec 8,862.75 = 52,126.00 vs the handwritten 52,026.00) — filer's arithmetic, retained verbatim. Schedule B row 5 purpose printed 'Wix Campaign Wegsite' (sic). Complete Address column bar-redacted on Schedule A; Occupation/Employer survives. Candidate herself appears as a contributor twice (11/7 and 11/22).
